elaine: :wave: Quick preboarding checklist for Samir (starts Mon). Two outstanding items: I-9 verification + background-check portal. @maria can you confirm his city/profile?

maria: He's remote (SF). I scheduled 10:00am orientation on Mon. Do remote hires need to do I-9 in person?

elaine: Short answer: yes — Section 2 of the I-9 requires in-person ID verification within 3 business days of start. Options: (1) bring original IDs to any Redwood office badge desk, (2) use an authorized agent (UPS/Notary) and upload the agent form, or (3) we can arrange a local trusted verifier. If he can't do any of those we can discuss exceptions but it'd delay badge. Sending the ID checklist below.

elaine: ```Required documents (one from List A) OR (one from List B AND one from List C):
- List A examples: U.S. passport, Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551)
- List B examples: Driver's license or state ID
- List C examples: Social Security card, birth certificate
Bring originals to the badge desk or upload clear photos to the BG portal (photo + front/back where requested).```

simon: Badge desk hours: 2nd floor lobby, Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00. We can pre-print the agent verification form and hold it at the desk 'Samir - People Ops' if you want.

jaz: IT update: I'll ship the laptop + power to his home today. I'll also send the Okta invite; he needs to complete MFA setup before Day 1. Please confirm the shipping address, @elaine.

elaine: Address confirmed via HR intake. Also, background check: the portal shows applicant email sent but no ID upload yet. @maria please nudge him to finish the doc upload.

maria: He said he finished the questionnaire but didn't upload the ID photos. I'll DM him now and ask for screenshots of the portal step.

onboarding-bot: Background check initiated for Samir. Status: Pending applicant ID upload. Reference: BG-2026-4589.

elaine: Plan: (A) @maria asks Samir to upload ID photos in the portal by Thurs EOD; (B) if not completed, Samir should visit badge desk Mon morning with originals; (C) @jaz confirms laptop tracking and delivery ETA; (D) @simon will leave the printed agent form at front desk. Anything else?

maria: :thumbsup: I'll ping him now. Also can you share the Day 1 agenda I can send?

```
